scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Wide inline story picture for chapter four of The Lanterns of the Hidden Valley. Images 1–3 are the approved simple Kasa Jizō inline style references; Image 4 is only a character and palette reference for Aoi and Ren. In Sayo’s small paper workshop beside the river at night, Aoi, a Japanese teenager with long dark hair, an ivory short-sleeved top, deep blue-grey skirt and brown shoulder bag, sits beside Sayo, an elderly Japanese woman with silver hair in a low bun, a muted plum work robe and sage apron. Sayo carefully cuts a narrow strip from the edge of an old lantern picture showing a woman in snow. Aoi watches with a small open notebook nearby; a few pale paper strips lie on the long table. Keep only the two women. Broad smooth matte colour areas, gentle contours, minimal faces and folds, very little texture, quiet workshop shapes, one warm lantern glow against cool blue night. Wide 12:7 composition. No readable writing, lettering, border, logo or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Wide inline story picture for chapter four of The Lanterns of the Hidden Valley. Images 1–3 are the approved simple Kasa Jizō inline style references; Image 4 is only a character and palette reference for Aoi and Ren. At night, show the paper workshop doorway and dark river. On the near bank, Aoi in an ivory top, deep blue-grey skirt and brown shoulder bag stands beside Sayo, an elderly woman with silver hair, a muted plum robe and sage apron. Across the water, Ren, a Japanese teenage boy with short dark hair, pale grey shirt, dark shorts and black backpack, stands beside Aoi’s elderly white-haired grandmother with a walking stick. A few villagers hold paper lanterns, making a small trail of golden lights across the far bank. The white paper bridge is made from overlapping sheets and reaches directly across the water, without timber, posts or rails. Broad smooth matte colours, gentle contours, minimal faces and folds, very little texture, quiet layered background; cool midnight blue with warm lantern light. Wide 12:7. Use case: illustration-story. Wide inline story picture for chapter four of The Lanterns of the Hidden Valley. Images 1–3 are the approved simple Kasa Jizō inline style references; Image 4 is only a character and palette reference for Aoi and Ren. On the white paper bridge over the river, Aoi, with long dark hair, ivory top, deep blue-grey skirt and brown shoulder bag, reaches the far bank and grasps Ren’s outstretched hand. She carries one small cracked bronze bell on a muted red cord in her other hand. Show one simple overlapping pale paper patch over the tear in the bridge. Behind her, Sayo, an elderly woman with silver hair in a low bun, muted plum robe and sage apron, braces the wooden gate at the workshop doorway with both hands; Sayo’s figure is only beginning to grow faint in its warm light. Keep one bridge, one gate and one bell; do not show what happens after this chapter. Broad smooth matte colour areas, gentle contours, minimal faces and folds, very little texture, quiet river and mountain shapes. Wide 12:7.
